next_step: Run 72hr soak using 6-node A100-equivalent dedicated pool; confirm p95 <200ms for 512-token prompts and report results to procurement
notes: POC objective: validate Dedicated throughput guarantees and latency SLOs under representative OxRidge production workload (low-latency chat + reranking).
Primary metrics: sustained tokens/sec (tps) at 99.9% availability, p50/p95/p99 latency on 256/512-token prompts, and per-1M-token cost estimate for committed capacity.

Representative prompts: (1) short chat turn ~40 tokens (context 2048 tokens), (2) user query + doc rerank batch of 16 items, (3) multi-paragraph summarization ~512 tokens. Provided small evaluation corpora in Drive link.

Throughput targets: baseline target 60 requests/sec with 512-token average request size (approx 30k tokens/sec aggregate), spike handling to 150 rps for 5 minutes, and automated fallback to smaller model under stress.
Latency SLOs: target p50 <50ms for short-turn chat, p95 <200ms for 512-token generation under normal load; p99 SLA discussion deferred to procurement stage.

Reserved GPU planning: OxRidge expects a 6-node pool (A100-equivalent) for initial commit; want capacity planning guidance for seasonal doubling and autoscale burst options. Discuss quantization tradeoffs for cost reduction.

Load test plan: synthetic traffic generator (internal) driving steady-state + spike scenarios; include KV cache warmup, batched rerank requests, and cold-start cycles (node recycle) to measure tail latencies.
Soak test plan: 72-hour continuous run at 70% peak load to validate sustained throughput, observe memory/latency drift, and confirm list of OOM/eviction events is zero or documented.
Quality gates: compare model outputs vs current internal baseline using an OxRidge-labeled eval dataset (ROUGE/BLEURT-like metrics) — target parity or better on key P1 intents.
SLA negotiation points: indemnity for data residency, detailed incident playbook, credits for p95/p99 misses, and defined maintenance windows. Legal wants example SLA language — linked in Drive.
Caching/optimization notes: want Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching thresholds, KV cache TTLs, and suggested quantization profiles for their reranking workload.
Security notes: SSO + audit logs are musts; will require KMS integration and at-rest encryption attestation. Security questionnaire shared 2026-03-02 (see Gmail thread).

Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-28): 'We need predictable per-token economics and rock-solid p95s — spikes are fine as long as they are graceful. We'll only commit if Dedicated shows stability over a week.'
Internal redwood action items: SE to deliver cluster sizing calc, performance runbook, and recommended rollout policy by 2026-03-16. Schedule procurement demo after soak completion.

poc_plan_summary: Three-phase POC: (1) Baseline single-node runs to characterize per-model perf and token cost; (2) Clustered load tests to validate throughput/latency under steady and spike patterns, including caching/kv warmup scenarios; (3) 72-hour soak at 70% peak for stability + failover drills. Deliverables: perf report, cluster sizing recommendation, SLA draft, and optimize config suggestions. SE Marcus Lee owns execution; procurement/contract handoff after successful soak.
